implementation.authoritative_version: file hashes include uncommitted source; git HEAD alone is insufficient

requires_frozen: initial orbit and its availability time
station reception tolerances and scoring rules
final_test.rule: Collect a new consecutive campaign after estimator/protocol freeze; dates must also follow all previously inspected data. Freeze campaign bounds before examining its imagery. Include failed and rejected passes.

policy.null_tolerance_meaning: No station-success claim until tolerances are specified before the campaign.

screening_parameters.threshold_origin: existing empirical heuristics, not literature-derived confidence bounds

unconsumed_inputs: CADU, power CSVs, and unrequested PNGs are not hashed or used in this experiment
